ambulance_primary.note: Supplied by the team for Madhya Pradesh from directory pages (india.gov.in, bhopal.nic.in). Confirm with the state NHM page before the demo.

transport_pregnant.label_en: Free ambulance for pregnant women and babies (Janani Express)
transport_pregnant.label_hi: गर्भवती महिलाओं और शिशुओं के लिए निःशुल्क एम्बुलेंस (जननी एक्सप्रेस)
transport_pregnant.note: Confirm service name and coverage in the demo state.

health_advice.note: HBNC leaflet says 'Dial 104'. Service varies by state.

mental_health.label_en: Tele-MANAS mental health support, free, 24 hours
mental_health.label_hi: टेली-मानस मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहायता, निःशुल्क, 24 घंटे

excluded_numbers.181: Not used. The description supplied for 181 (CM Helpline / Janani Suraksha queries) is inconsistent with a maternal helpline. Add only after the state NHM page confirms what it does.

ui_number_policy: The call button reads numbers.ambulance_primary.number from this file. Never hard-code a number in components. The Trust page lists every number with its status.

entitlements.jssk_en: Under the Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK), government hospitals provide free delivery, medicines, tests, food and transport between home and hospital. Ask the ambulance team or the hospital.
entitlements.jssk_hi: जननी शिशु सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम (JSSK) के तहत सरकारी अस्पताल में प्रसव, दवाएँ, जाँच, भोजन और घर से अस्पताल तक का परिवहन निःशुल्क मिलता है। एम्बुलेंस टीम या अस्पताल से पूछिए।

deadline_guard.note: Any commit after the official deadline means disqualification. The pre-commit hook blocks commits after hard_stop_iso.
